DisplayName: bugfixes > fix forge chat link crash > enabled
Description: Fixes crash when certain invalid URLs appear in chat. Compatibility note: Not compatible with `fixUrlDetection` in Hodgepodge 1.6.14 and higher, which does the same (this feature will be disabled). [default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > bugfixes.fix_forge_chat_link_crash]

[default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > bugfixes.fix_heightmap_range]

DisplayName: bugfixes > fix small entity swim > enabled
Description: Fixes bug in entity swimming code resulting in small entities (ones with hitboxes less than 0.8 units tall, such as DMod's foxes) being prone to drowning. [default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > bugfixes.fix_small_entity_swim]

DisplayName: bugfixes > forge fix logger class loading error > enabled
Description: Fixes the NoClassDefFoundError that can occur when FML logs an exception originating from a coremod, losing the original exception in the process. This ostensibly happens due to a bug in the version of log4j that 1.7.10 ships with. [default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > bugfixes.forge_fix_logger_class_loading_error]

DisplayName: bugfixes > use spawn type for mob cap > enabled
Description: Use the spawn type of mobs to determine which mob cap they should count towards, rather than their class. Fixes aquatic mobs spawning endlessly with certain mods. [default: false] [config/coretweaks.cfg > bugfixes.use_spawn_type_for_mob_cap]

DisplayName: diagnostics > detect data watcher id conflicts > enabled
Description: Emit warning when a mod registers a typed DataWatcher object in an already occupied ID slot (vanilla only warns in the typeless registration method). [default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > diagnostics.detect_data_watcher_id_conflicts]

DisplayName: diagnostics > detect data watcher id conflicts > detectDataWatcherIdConflictCulprit

DisplayName: diagnostics > enhance map storage errors > enabled
Description: Makes MapStorage's errors more informative. [default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > diagnostics.enhance_map_storage_errors]

Exclude libraries from being transformed. Speeds up startup slightly. This will break any mods that try to transform these libraries, though that's fairly unlikely. [default: true] [config/coretweaks.cfg > optimizations.exclude_library_transformation]

DisplayName: optimizations > fast default resource pack > enabled

DisplayName: optimizations > fast folder resource pack > enabled

DisplayName: optimizations > forge fast deobfuscation remapper > enabled

DisplayName: optimizations > forge fast progress bar > enabled

DisplayName: optimizations > forge fast step message strip > enabled

[SERVER] Conversion ratio between Pressurized Water and EU on pressure 1. Affects the throughput on pipes between multi blocks and how much energy is stored in each Hydro Dam. [config/hydroenergy.cfg > energy balance]

[SERVER] How many EU are added to a dam during rain for each water block on the highest Y coordinate aka water surface when full. [config/hydroenergy.cfg > energy balance]

[SERVER + CLIENT] If water is sitting too narrow over a block there are graphical issues (Depth buffer resolution). To fix this, the game will not render a waterLevel that sits lower then the specified value over a block. This value is also used for physics calculation and is synced from the server all clients. [config/hydroenergy.cfg > general]

[SERVER] Delay in milliseconds the game will wait between processing a chunk for water spreading. Keep in mind, that a single tick takes care of a whole chunk between y=0 and y=255 at once! [config/hydroenergy.cfg > general]

[CLIENT] Some Macs may always report OpenGL 2.1 - activate this to disable the OpenGL 3.2 check; it will assume you have OpenGL 3.2 or greater. But be warned: it may crash! [config/hydroenergy.cfg > general]

[SERVER] How many dams should the game support. At least as many as the server you want to connect to. Each dam will receive its own water block and it will also have a minuscule performance impact. Keep it only as long as you need. You can always just raise, but not shorten the value. Value must be between 1 and 16. [config/hydroenergy.cfg > general]

[CLIENT] Light calculation required all affected chunks to be rerendered. When a change in waterLevel induces rerendering it will also calculate a minimum delay before it can happen again. Light updates will not be lost, just delayed. For every subChunk (16 blocks high) that was rerendered because of this update event, the game will add the specified delay (in milliseconds) up for the actual delay. You should expect the number of rerendered subChunks to be in the low hundreds [config/hydroenergy.cfg > general]
[SERVER] Minimum delay in milliseconds between update packets from the server to ALL clients. [config/hydroenergy.cfg > general]

The maximum number of buildcraft pipes (including forks) between logistics pipes. This is an indicator of the maximum amount of nodes the recursion algorithm will visit before giving up. As it is possible to fork a pipe connection using standard BC pipes the algorithm will attempt to discover all available destinations through that pipe. Do note that the logistics system will not interfere with the operation of non-logistics pipes. So a forked pipe will usually be sup-optimal, but it is possible. A low value might reduce CPU usage, a high value will be able to handle more complex pipe setups.  [config/LogisticsPipes.cfg > general]

The maximum shortest length between logistics pipes. This is an indicator on the maxim depth of the recursion algorithm to discover logistics neighbours. A low value might use less CPU, a high value will allow longer pipe sections [config/LogisticsPipes.cfg > general]

the number of hours that an item will power a Passive Anchor this is an approximation only, actual duration is affected by number of chunks loaded and tick rate if the list is empty, Passive Anchors will not require fuel, default = 12 Entry Format: <modid>:<itemname>#<metadata>=<value> Example: personal.fuel= minecraft:ender_pearl=12, minecraft:coal#0=4 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > anchors]

change to 'useAltRecipes=true' to use track recipes more similar to vanilla minecraft [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.track]
change to 'ores=false' to prevent the game from crushing ores into dusts (only available if IC2 installed) [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.rockcrusher]
set the output of the coalcoke and stick recipe for torches, setting to 0 will disable' min=0, default=8, max=32 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.misc]
set the output of the creosote and woool recipe for torches, setting to 0 will disable' min=0, default=6, max=16 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.misc]
change to 'gunpowder=false' to disable the sulfur, saltpeter, charcoal dust recipe for gunpowder [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.misc]
change to 'bronze=false' to disable the bronze recipe for minecarts [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.cart]
change to 'furnace=true' to enable the Furnace Minecart recipe [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.cart]
change to 'steel=false' to disable the steel recipe for minecarts [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.railcraft.cart]
change to 'blaze=false' to disable the IC2 Macerator recipe for Blaze Powder [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.ic2.macerator]
change to 'bones=false' to disable the IC2 Macerator recipe for Bonemeal [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.ic2.macerator]
change to 'charcoal=false' to disable the IC2 Macerator recipe for Charcoal Dust [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.ic2.macerator]
change to 'cobble=false' to disable the IC2 Macerator recipes for Cobblestone [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.ic2.macerator]
change to 'dirt=false' to disable the IC2 Macerator recipe for Dirt [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.ic2.macerator]
change to 'obsidian=false' to disable the IC2 Macerator recipes for Cushed Obsidian and Obsidian Dust [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > recipes.ic2.macerator]

set the minimum number of seconds between cart dispensing, default=0 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.cartdispenser]
Change to 'allow.stacking=false' to disable the stacking of Iron Tanks [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.irontank]
Allows you to set the max Iron Tank base dimension, valid values are 3, 5, 7, and 9 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.irontank]
measured in tick, smaller numbers update more often, resulting in more sensitive signals, but cost more cpu power, default = 4 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.signals]
change to 'requirePower=false' to disable the Power Requirements for most machines [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.machines]
adjust the heat value of BioFuel in a Boiler [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.boiler]
adjust the heat value of Fuel in a Boiler [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.blocks.boiler]
adjust the amount of fuel used to create Steam, min=0.2, default=1.0, max=6.0 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.steam]

change 'max.speed' to limit max speed on high speed rails, useful if your computer can't keep up with chunk loading, min=0.6, default=0.8, max=1.2 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.tracks.speed]
change the value to your desired max launch rail force, min=5, default=30, max=50 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.tracks.launch]
change to 'ops.only=true' to limit the editing of Golden Tickets to server admins only [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.routing]
change to 'breakOnDrop=true' to restore vanilla behavior [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.general]
change to 'collideWithItems=true' to restore minecart collisions with dropped items, ignored if 'register.collision.handler=false' [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.general]
change the value to your desired minecart stack size, vanilla=1, default=3, max=64 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.general]
change to 'register.collision.handler=false' to use a minecart collision handler from a different mod or vanilla behavior [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.general]

change to 'solid.carts=false' to return minecarts to vanilla player vs cart collision behavior in vanilla minecarts are ghost like can be walked through but making carts solid also makes them hard to push by hand this setting is ignored if aren't using the Railcraft Collision Handler [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.general]

change to 'adjustDrag=false' to give basic carts the original vanilla drag values, after changing you may need to replace the carts to see any change in game [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.basic]
change to 'allowLiquids=true' to allow you put cans/capsules in Chest Carts [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.chest]
change to 'destroyBlocks=true' to cause the Bore to destroy the blocks it mines instead of dropping them [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.bore]
change to 'mineAllBlocks=false' to enable mining checks, use true setting with caution, especially on servers [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.bore]

add block ids to 'mineableBlocks' in a common seperated list to define non-vanilla blocks mineable by the tunnel bore ignored if 'tweaks.carts.bore.mineAllBlocks=true' metadata sensative entries can be defined in the form 'modid:blockname#metadata' Example:mineableBlocks= { minecraft:stone, minecraft:stonebrick#3 } [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.bore]
adjust the speed at which the Bore mines blocks, min=0.1, default=1.0, max=50.0 [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.bore]
change to 'damageMobs=false' to disable Locomotive damage on mobs, they will still knockback mobs [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.locomotive]

controls how much power locomotives have and how many carts they can pull be warned, longer trains have a greater chance for glitches as such it HIGHLY recommended you do not change this [config/railcraft/railcraft.cfg > tweaks.carts.locomotive]

DisplayName: serverutilities > backups > backup entire regions with claims
Description: Backup entire regions that contain at least one claimed chunk. This backs up complete .mca files instead of reconstructing temporary files with only claimed chunks. Requires only_backup_claimed_chunks to be enabled. [default: false] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]
Path to backups folder. [default: ./backups/] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]

Time between backups. Examples: 30m, 1h, 6h, 1d. Units: s=seconds, m=minutes, h=hours, d=24 hours, w=7 days. Positive integers only; minimum 1s. Values without units are legacy hours, converted and saved with units on startup. Legacy hours round up to whole seconds; zero becomes 1s. Invalid values prevent automatic backups until corrected; manual backups remain available. [default: 30m] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]

Number of backup files to keep before deleting old ones. Always preserves the latest eligible backup per world. Ignored when retention_policy is nonempty. [range: 1 ~ 2147483647, default: 12] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]
How much the backup file will be compressed. 0 - uncompressed, 1 - best speed, 9 - smallest file size. [range: 0 ~ 9, default: 1] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]

DisplayName: serverutilities > backups > delete custom name backups
Description: Delete backups that have a custom name set through /backup start <name> [default: true] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]
Enables backups. [default: true] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]

Size allowance for rotating backup archives in GB. Deletes eligible old backups when exceeded. 0 = Disabled and backups_to_keep will be used instead, unless retention_policy is set. With legacy retention, counts only eligible ZIP files and preserves the newest eligible backup per world. Protected custom backups are excluded from the size allowance in both modes. Unrecognized/unreadable and future-dated archives are also preserved and excluded. With retention_policy, removes the oldest finite-retention backups after age pruning. Forever representatives are also excluded from the allowance; tota [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]

Skip automatic backups while no players are online and no player activity is pending. Login/logout activity permits a final backup after everyone leaves; failed attempts remain pending. Retention uses elapsed time, so empty-server periods can leave gaps in policy history. Set false for backups while empty, especially if automation keeps changing the world. [default: true] [serverutilities/serverutilities.cfg > backups]

Description: Statistical variance in skin tone for a population decreases as the number of skin-tone-affecting biome tags increases. DisplayName: general > villager skin tones > Skin Tone Variance Scale
Description: Proportionality constant for variance everywhere, irrespective of biome. Set this to zero for absolutely no variation for a given biome. I estimate that the distribution is flattest, and thus population variance is maximized, around a value of about 2.6. [range: 0.0 ~ 3.4028235E38, default: 1.0] [config/VillageNames4/general.cfg > villager skin tones]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Livestock Restriction Level

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Size: Maximum
Description: Upper limit for the randomly-selected size of a village. Vanilla is 1. [range: 1.0 ~ 5.0, default: 1.0] [config/VillageNames4/newvillages/village_gen.cfg > village generator]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Size: Minimum
Description: Lower limit for the randomly-selected size of a village. Vanilla is 1. [range: 1.0 ~ 5.0, default: 1.0] [config/VillageNames4/newvillages/village_gen.cfg > village generator]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Size: Mode
Description: Peak of the distribution for the randomly-selected size of a village: the most probable village size. Irrelevant for Normal Order of 1 or when Maximum and Minimum are equal. Must be in the range of [Minimum, Maximum]. [range: 1.0 ~ 10.0, default: 1.0] [config/VillageNames4/newvillages/village_gen.cfg > village generator]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Size: Normal Order
Description: Village size is drawn from a convolution of this many uniform distributions. A value of 1 is uniform: all values in the range are equally likely. A value of 2 is triangular. Increasing this more narrowly centers the distribution around the value entered for Mode. [range: 1 ~ 10, default: 1] [config/VillageNames4/newvillages/village_gen.cfg > village generator]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Spacing: Median
Description: Median distance between villages. Vanilla is 20. [range: 1 ~ 100, default: 20] [config/VillageNames4/newvillages/village_gen.cfg > village generator]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Spacing: Range
Description: Variation in distances between villages. Must be lower than Median value. Vanilla is 12. [range: 1 ~ 100, default: 12] [config/VillageNames4/newvillages/village_gen.cfg > village generator]

DisplayName: village gen > village generator > Village Spacing: Village-Free Radius
